supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic HTTPS activity is visible from 13:37 to 14:07 UTC as repeated proxy CONNECT requests to updates.pixelforge-suite.com, approximately every five minutes.

The successful updater-domain connections are attributed by endpoint network events to C:\Program Files\PixelForge\pfupdater.exe, matching the documented PixelForge updater and its expected update-check cadence and domain.
One updater-domain attempt at 13:42 UTC was rejected by the proxy with status 407; subsequent requests to that same domain succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records identify the CONNECT destination and tunnel metadata, but do not expose the HTTPS contents, requested paths, or downloaded update data.
The supplied records show the repeated requests from 13:37 through 14:07 UTC, but do not include corresponding updater-domain connections for 13:30–13:37 or 14:08–14:10 UTC.
claims_not_established: The available evidence does not establish what content was exchanged inside the HTTPS tunnels or whether the updater binary and returned update content were authentic.
The evidence does not establish whether any activity occurred during the portions of the alert interval not represented by updater-domain connection records.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain TLS inspection or equivalent network evidence for the updater connections, including certificate details and any available URL or content metadata.
Verify the pfupdater.exe signature and hash against the organization's approved PixelForge distribution, and validate the update artifact or vendor release information.
Confirm proxy and endpoint network telemetry coverage for the full 13:30–14:10 UTC alert interval.
unrelated_findings: DropboxUpdate.exe ran as SYSTEM on WS-LMARTINS-01; Dropbox is not listed as approved. The records do not establish that this process made an outbound connection, and this is separate from the PixelForge updater activity. (T046-00119, T046-00120, T046-00127, T046-00128)

WS-LMARTINS-01 queried x7k9m2.akamaized.net, resolving to 151.101.25.122; the DNS event is attributed to svchost.exe, and the records do not establish its relationship to the alerted updater connections. (T046-00124, T046-00126)
